statement: One shared endpoint-and-gap protocol for four independent HVP classes. The comparison rule and band are fixed by this file before any class evaluation under it, and the tabulated-class band was declared on the postdiction ledger before this file existed. A class without a frozen in-repository ingest cannot be evaluated and receives the explicit not-evaluable verdict with its exact ingest requirement.

shared_protocol.endpoint_object: alpha_inv at the Thomson endpoint under the self-consistent insertion convention
shared_protocol.gap_object: same-scheme anchor gap between the physical on-shell reference and the OPH one-loop unification anchor
shared_protocol.comparison_rule: a class confirms when its reference deficit lies inside the certified same-scheme anchor-gap interval of the pinned endpoint payload; it refutes when the deficit lies outside; missing covariance is reported, never imputed

kill_band.declaration_site: postdiction ledger anchor-gap row and the pinned anchor-scheme bridge artifact

tabulated_dispersive.description: published tabulated dispersive compilation, KNT19 pinned shape carrier
tabulated_dispersive.ingest: code/particles/reference_store is not consumed; the pinned payload enters through hadron/ingest_empirical_ee_hadrons.py with Delta alpha_had5 = 0.027609 +- 0.000112 and the recorded pin factor
tabulated_dispersive.blind_status: the band was declared before this protocol file; the class value was recorded before this file, so this row is a replayed comparison, not a fresh blind evaluation

raw_dispersive.description: raw e+e- hadronic cross-section data with kernel, exclusions, and covariance
raw_dispersive.ingest_requirement: frozen channel-level cross-section tables with covariance and an explicit kernel specification, none of which is in the repository

independent_code.description: an independent published evaluation code distinct from the pinned compilation chain
independent_code.ingest_requirement: a pinned independent implementation with its release, inputs, and license, none of which is in the repository

lattice_hvp.description: lattice HVP determination with windowed data and covariance
lattice_hvp.ingest_requirement: frozen lattice windowed data files with covariance and continuum, volume, and scale-setting documentation, none of which is in the repository

fabrication_exclusion: class values recalled from literature memory are not ingests; a class row without a frozen repository ingest cannot be marked evaluated
